scope: 65 expanded terrain specifications plus all 97 live AREAS navigation queries; no gameplay state or layout changes

api.gorges: id,x,z,width,depth,y,drop,bankWidth,kind,walkable; y=center bed height; actual surface follows terrain.height
api.newBridgeRule: exact flat deck height throughout footprint, smooth 8m transition; original 32 excluded from this new flattening

legacy32Proof.sampling: 2m grid over each original area plus original bridge centreline at .5m; original ramps/waters/bridges/brokenBridges/barriers included in each SHA256

existingChecks.typecheck: npm run check passed before final source validation
existingChecks.terrainAndNavigation: existing 8 tests passed across current 97 areas; no new test cases/dependencies
